summary: Hosted API: streaming sends a few chunks then goes silent until client timeout
description: Customer says streaming begins normally (first 2-5 data: lines) then no more events. Connection appears open; their client eventually times out. Happens only on one model in eu-west. They do not see 5xx.
comments: Support (Lauren): Asked if they are behind Cloudflare / enterprise proxy; customer says yes (CF).
Eng (Alex): Checked runtime logs: generation completed; gateway did not flush final bytes to client for 3 affected request_ids.
Eng: Hypothesis: buffering at intermediate proxy due to small chunks + delayed flush; suggested setting 'stream_options: {include_usage:true}' to increase chunk frequency and adding keep-alive pings.
Support: Waiting for customer to confirm whether keep-alives resolve.
